references.text: Israel gathered food (manna) as provisions in the wilderness, a parallel to the need to prepare supplies
Moses announces that Israel will cross the Jordan to take possession of the land, the same theme Joshua conveys
The promise to cross the Jordan and take possession of the land that the Lord gives them
Joshua commands the people to get ready to cross the Jordan within three days
After three days, the leaders go through the camp and give orders to follow the ark of the covenant across the Jordan
The fulfillment of the promise - the priests stood on dry ground while Israel crossed the Jordan
The people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal - the completion of the crossing
The Lord's command to take possession of the land that he has given them as an inheritance
The exhortation to keep the commands in order to live, enter, and take possession of the land
